groups.title: Beyond the Guard
groups.sub: Allies, enemies, and the ones who came before

characters.name: Abhimanyu Rathore
characters.role: The heart of the Shadow Guard
characters.quote: Can I be the person this world can trust?
characters.bio: The main protagonist. A brilliant young mind whose prototype opened a door to the cosmic unknown, now bearing the weight of a tragedy that awakened his latent destiny.

characters.name: Ishani Sanghvi
characters.quote: A hunter tracks rabid dogs. Surrender, or there will be no ashes left of you to bury.
characters.bio: One of the fiercest women in the Astral world, tracking rogue threats across continents with fiery thermal claws.

characters.name: Kunal Nasser
characters.quote: We have seen wars and battles, chaos and destruction. Will humans ever stop?
characters.bio: Leader of the Shadow Guard. An experienced veteran tasked with guiding the next generation of Astrals through cosmic turmoil.

characters.name: Aadhya Mira
characters.quote: This world needs that trust… Be their trust Abhimanyu, be my trust…
characters.bio: Abhimanyu's lifelong partner, whose unwavering faith and final wish gave birth to the awakening of the cosmic wielder.

characters.name: Raj Vetramani
characters.quote: The nation must exist. But for that, you need to live.
characters.bio: A legendary hero who defined selfless sacrifice. He gave his life defending Delhi and the Artifact against Shan Ziang.

characters.name: Veraya Pillai
characters.quote: Raj did not trust you… and neither do I. You will never find the Artifact again!
characters.bio: Model turned fierce Astral operative who fought alongside Raj Vetramani and leaped into the Satvati River to keep the Artifact from falling into enemy hands.

characters.name: Shan Ziang
characters.quote: The world doesn't have time. No one does.
characters.bio: A supreme Astral wielding a Kusarigama that cleaved mountains. His insatiable obsession with the Artifact brought Delhi to ruins.

characters.name: Butcher
characters.role: Assassin of the Order of Tombs
characters.quote: There is a lot more fun to killing than just completing a job, kid.
characters.bio: The cold-blooded Astral assassin of the Order of Tombs who orchestrated the massacre at the Verakhonda Museum in Jaipur.
